name: Traminho
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Original Soulmonsters evolutionary family, a flagship partner creature with distinct living-kite anatomy. 45% expressive creature,45% FUNCTIONAL LIVING KITE body,10% authorial clean 2D manga and selective stepped outer contour. One creature, one fullbody threequarter hero pose on WHITE with ample margins. No text, other characters, pose duplicates, scenery or effects hiding body. Crisp strong dark line, vivid flat colors, ONE hard cel shadow, simple broad shapes, large quiet planes, NO airbrush/gradient/CGI, fur, noisy triangle tessellation, huge scale texture or ornament spam. Family palette vermilion/coral-orange body, midnight indigo structural surfaces, warm ivory belly/muzzle/fold interiors, small golden bamboo and amber eyes. Living folded tension-paper makes body volume, curved spars are anatomical edges, knot is an articulation; NOT real dinosaur wearing a kite backpack. NO patches, clothes, logos, heart symbols, named franchise designs or copied head/body silhouette. A continuous cord rabiola contains the creature's soul, never disconnected, ending in TWO flat chevron paper tabs (baby only ONE). Signature recurring features: broad rounded TRAPEZOID reptile muzzle with a crisp ivory lower face, offset ivory chevron on forehead not a letter or symbol copied from a franchise, TWO short swept INDIGO folded paper cheek-keels instead of horns/ears, a diagonal coral/ivory abdominal fold held by one small gold side-knot. No fire on tail, no dinosaur skull helmet, no swords, humanoid armor, wings added everywhere or magic orb. All limbs and roots readable.
BABY of attached own Tramino reptile-paper family, provisional name Traminho. SIMPLE small single squat asymmetric paper seed-body that is ALSO the head, no separate torso/neck/arms/hands/legs or dinosaur anatomy miniaturized. Rounded trapezoid forehead with one small soft ivory forward fold, two very small indigo swept cheek-tabs act as stabilizers, wide amber curious eyes and a tiny sideways pleased mouth, warm ivory underside and little blunt muzzle fold. Vermilion upper paper envelope, ivory front, deep indigo base folded under like a flexible cradle. ONE short gold soul-tail cord with ONE chevron ivory/indigo tab and gold knot. Leaning forward to bounce, one cheek-tab flexed, living expressive baby not a flat smiling logo. Keep only a few contour bends and one shadow, no many facets or adult teeth. No weapon or fire. One body only.
identity: Corpo único de papel com estabilizadores laterais e uma aba em chevron.
story: Aprende a recuperar tensão e equilíbrio para dar o primeiro impulso.
review: Sem tronco separado ou pernas, dois estabilizadores e uma aba de rabiola. A face ainda é bastante próxima da criança; maior simplicidade facial pode ser testada se o autor desejar. Não é bebê automaticamente aprovado.

name: Tramino
prompt: Create an original friendly fantasy companion creature concept for the game Soulmonsters, called Tramino (do not write the name in image). One complete creature in three-quarter view on white, clean 2D manga cel illustration, crisp dark outline and flat vivid colors. It is a small bipedal paper reptile whose actual body is made from living folded kite paper, not an ordinary animal wearing accessories. Vermilion/coral body, warm ivory trapezoid muzzle and belly, midnight indigo folds, tiny golden bamboo edges and amber eyes. Broad angular but welcoming face with short reptile muzzle, tiny nostrils, friendly asymmetrical grin and one discreet small tooth. One offset ivory forehead fold, two small swept indigo cheek-keels; no horns or tall ears. Two short arms with three blunt finger-claws, two bent sturdy legs with two broad toes, forearm folds form small triangular membranes continuously connected to anatomy. A diagonal belly fold held by one small gold knot at flank. A short rear tail transitions into a continuous gold cord with two ivory/indigo chevron paper tabs. Brave, curious, slightly impulsive personality, one forepaw reaching invitingly forward in an energetic step. Strong simple memorable silhouette, quiet color areas, one hard cel shadow, no textures, gradients or realistic rendering. Material balance: living creature and kite-paper equally important, with a little selective stepped contour. Generous margins, all tail tabs and feet visible. No writing, logo, scenery, duplicate poses, copied franchise features, costumes, armor, fire or weapons.
identity: Pequeno réptil bípede de papel, testa marfim, antebraços com membranas e rabiola bifurcada de duas abas.
story: Curioso e impulsivo, sempre chama o parceiro para seguir antes de conferir o caminho.
review: Dois braços e duas pernas; três dígitos na mão próxima, mão distante parcialmente ocluída. Dois dedos nos pés. Rabiola bifurca em duas abas. A testa possui uma vela mais alta que no brief inicial; passa a ser característica observada do piloto. A composição tem pouca margem na mão próxima, sem corte visível.

name: Tramassauro
prompt: Correct the anatomy of this original paper fantasy creature illustration. There is a small extra foot under the center of the torso, immediately behind the large central foreground paw. Remove that small extra foot and fill its former area with the white background and appropriate ground shadow. The final creature should have exactly four legs and four feet. Preserve the four large or clearly attached feet, head, pose, colors, paper folds, foreleg panels, tail and all other details. This is a small cleanup edit, not a redesign.
identity: Quadrúpede de massas dianteiras fortes; membranas de contenção contínuas aos antebraços.
story: Deixa de correr sozinho e aprende a interceptar para abrir passagem ao parceiro.
review: Rascunho inicial gerou cinco patas. Edição final removeu o pé pequeno sob ventre: quatro apoios visíveis. As raízes das pernas distantes ficam parcialmente ocluídas e precisam de perfil para confirmar o modelo completo. Preservado rascunho falho apenas como histórico, sem usá-lo no chart.

name: Tramadraco
prompt: A clean 2D manga concept illustration of an original majestic dragon made of living folded kite paper, standing in three-quarter view on a white background. Midnight indigo body, coral-orange folded wings and limbs, ivory muzzle and chest, amber eyes, curved golden bamboo wing edges. Four animal legs and two broad kite-sail wings, all joints clear, all feet and wing tips inside generous margins. Mature angular friendly-serious face, long trapezoid muzzle, low ivory forehead crest, swept indigo cheek fins. Powerful compact body with a broad folded-paper chest. A short tail continues into a golden cord with two ivory-and-indigo chevron paper tabs. One wing opening and the other partially folded, regal grounded stance. Flat vivid colors, crisp dark outlines, simple cel shading, broad calm shapes without texture. One complete character only, no text or scenery.
identity: Dragão de quatro pernas e duas asas-vela, corpo índigo e peito de dobras marfim.
story: Troca a arrancada isolada pela sustentação: torna-se guia de uma passagem aérea para os demais.
review: Quatro pernas e duas asas com raízes distintas, duas abas conectadas à rabiola. A geração final não recebeu imagem-base: parentesco foi guiado por texto, mantendo cores/testa/chevron, mas adicionando mais pontas na cabeça e dobras que no piloto. Raízes das asas e grau de recolhimento exigem vistas; a pose não prova voo ou capacidade de transporte.
